newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil gov't to meet coffee exporters January 13.
newsitem.headline: Brazil gov't to meet coffee exporters January 13.

text.p: The head of the primary commodities department at Brazil's Industry and Commerce Ministry will meet exporters within Brazil's Coffee Exporters' Federation (Febec) on January 13, officials said.
The meeting, to be held at 1100 local/1300 GMT in Febec's headquarters in Rio de Janeiro, is one of a series of regular monthly sessions to discuss the progress of exports.
By January 13, there should be a final figure for December exports, expected to close at around 1.55 million 60-kg bags.
As of January 8, December shipments based on bills of lading were 1.53 million bags, according to today's bulletin from the Rio de Janeiro Coffee Center.
A figure of 1.55 million bags would bring total shipments in the July to December period to just under the nine million bags agreed with other producing countries.
((-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
